caption:
How I saved $100k in two years ↓

1. 💄 No new makeup. I’m grateful to receive PR items too, but I say no new makeup to expand my collection, only to replace empty items

2. 🎮 No subscriptions services for entertainment or shopping. Recurring subscriptions can add up in the long term, so be selective with which ones you keep

3. 📱 No device or tech upgrades. I don’t need a new iPhone or MacBook every year, so no new devices until my current one stops working

caption:
Do you actually have taste or are you just chasing the rat race of keeping up with trends? 

Having good taste in 2026 has nothing to do with knowing which trends are in and which are out. It’s something much harder than that.

It’s staying true to yourself despite the temptation. And right now that temptation is everywhere … in your feed, in your algorithm, in every “you need this” video telling you what to want next.

The most stylish women I know aren’t wearing the most current things. They’re wearing things they’re completely certain about. 

You already have it. You just have to stop letting the internet talk you out of it 🖤
